The Organization entity represents the Okta tenant itself. It contains general information about the organization, such as its name, domain, and settings.

relationship_kinds.name: Okta_ResourceSetContainsIndirect
relationship_kinds.description: Indirect membership of users within an Okta resource set through a group

markdown.content:
The non-traversable Okta_ResourceSetContainsIndirect edges represent users that are members of a resource set indirectly through a group membership in Okta.

These edges are created when a resource set contains the members of a group, which is represented by the Okta_ResourceSetContainsMembersOf edge. The collector resolves the current group membership and creates one Okta_ResourceSetContainsIndirect edge per member user. As a result, users who join or leave the group gain or lose the corresponding resource set membership, and thereby become or stop being targets of any custom role assignment scoped to the resource set.

Users that are added to a resource set directly are represented by the Okta_ResourceSetContains edges. The union of Okta_ResourceSetContains and Okta_ResourceSetContainsIndirect edges covers all objects that a role assignment scoped to the resource set applies to.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/okta/edges/okta_resourcesetcontainsindirect)

relationship_kinds.name: Okta_ResetPassword
relationship_kinds.description: Ability to reset passwords or temporary credentials for scoped Okta users

markdown.content:
The traversable Okta_ResetPassword edges represent custom role permissions that allow a principal (user, group, or application) to reset passwords or temporary credentials for scoped Okta users. These edges are created when a custom role includes password management permissions such as `okta.users.credentials.resetPassword`, `okta.users.credentials.manage`, `okta.users.credentials.manageTemporaryAccessCode`, or `okta.users.manage`.

The edge is calculated based on custom role scoping.

Alice is a direct member of the resource set, while Bob is a member indirectly through the Retail Staff group. Both are therefore in scope of the role assignment.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/okta/edges/okta_resetpassword)

relationship_kinds.name: Okta_ResetFactors
relationship_kinds.description: Ability to reset MFA factors for scoped Okta users

markdown.content:
The traversable Okta_ResetFactors edges represent custom role permissions that allow a principal to reset MFA authenticators for scoped Okta users. These edges are created when a custom role includes the `okta.users.credentials.resetFactors` or `okta.users.credentials.manage` permissions.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/okta/edges/okta_resetfactors)

relationship_kinds.name: Okta_AppAdmin
relationship_kinds.description: Application administrator role assignment

markdown.content:
The traversable Okta_AppAdmin edges represent Application Administrator role assignments. Application Administrators can manage application configurations, user assignments, and provisioning settings for their assigned applications.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/okta/edges/okta_appadmin)

relationship_kinds.name: Okta_GroupAdmin
relationship_kinds.description: Group administrator role assignment

markdown.content:
The traversable Okta_GroupAdmin edges represent Group Administrator (also known as User Administrator) role assignments. Group Administrators can manage users and groups within their assigned scope.

Target group memberships are flattened when the assignment is evaluated.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/okta/edges/okta_groupadmin)

relationship_kinds.name: Okta_GroupMembershipAdmin
relationship_kinds.description: Group membership administrator role assignment

markdown.content:
The traversable Okta_GroupMembershipAdmin edges represent Group Membership Administrator role assignments. Group Membership Administrators can add and remove members from groups within their assigned scope but cannot modify the groups themselves.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/okta/edges/okta_groupmembershipadmin)

relationship_kinds.name: Okta_HelpDeskAdmin
relationship_kinds.description: Help desk administrator role assignment

markdown.content:
The traversable Okta_HelpDeskAdmin edges represent Help Desk Administrator role assignments. Help Desk Administrators can perform password resets, unlock accounts, and reset MFA factors for users within their assigned scope.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/okta/edges/okta_helpdeskadmin)

relationship_kinds.name: Okta_SuperAdmin
relationship_kinds.description: Super administrator role assignment

markdown.content:
The traversable Okta_SuperAdmin edges represent Super Administrator role assignments, which are scoped to the entire Okta organization. Super Administrators have full access to all features and settings in the Okta organization.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/okta/edges/okta_superadmin)

relationship_kinds.name: Okta_OrgAdmin
relationship_kinds.description: Organization administrator role assignment

markdown.content:
The traversable Okta_OrgAdmin edges represent Organization Administrator role assignments. Organization Administrators can manage most organizational settings except for administrative role assignments and some security settings.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/okta/edges/okta_orgadmin)

relationship_kinds.name: Okta_MobileAdmin
relationship_kinds.description: Mobile administrator role assignment

markdown.content:
The traversable Okta_MobileAdmin edges represent Mobile Administrator role assignments. Mobile Administrators can manage mobile device settings and configurations within their assigned scope.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/okta/edges/okta_mobileadmin)
